When a 15-year-old boy is murdered after getting in over his head, detectives hope a Snapchat message can lead them to his killer.

When a man is found shot and dumped in the road, detectives learn how his struggle to overcome obstacles left him headed for a collision with someone on the edge.

description:

The killing of a foreign exchange student is captured on video; family members are involved in a shooting at a New Orleans car wash.

description:
S01 E02 — Bad Tempered; The Bully
A caretaker in Atlanta gets gunned down over a grudge; a young man in Tulsa, Okla., dies when a bully goes too far; includes bonus footage.

description:

A Tulsa, Okla., detective hunts a family of elusive criminals after a former Marine is fatally shot while trying to recover his stolen bicycle.

title: Alaska PD
description:
S01 E02 — Wild Wild West
In Kotzebue, Sgt. Norman Hughes gets more than he bargained for on a domestic violence call; officer Robert Odom faces the dangers of working alone; in Fairbanks, a pizza van is carjacked, and the suspect is armed and loose in the city.

title: Alaska PD
description:
S01 E06 — There's the Good, the Bad and Then There's Alaska
Alaska is home to many people who live by their own rules, which means law enforcement must deal with quirky characters of all kinds on a daily basis; some are good, some are bad and some are downright hilarious.

title: Alaska PD
description:
S01 E07 — Last Frontier
Petersburg rookies learn that being an Alaska cop sometimes means saving eagles and battling fires; in Fairbanks, during his last weeks before retirement, Sgt. Peyton Meredith and his officers engage in high-speed chases under dangerous conditions.

title: Alaska PD
description:
S01 E03 — Taste of Blood
In Fairbanks, a wanted fugitive flees into the woods and the police's only lead is frozen footprints in the snow; when a killer bear becomes loose in Kodiak, officers must hunt it down before it strikes again.

title: Alaska PD
description:
S01 E01 — Call of the Wild
Jaime Ramos from Virginia becomes Kodiak PD's only female police officer, and soon has her first encounter with the infamous Kodiak bear; Fairbanks officer Gerrit Butler, a former MMA professional, encounters a suspect who also knows martial arts.

title: Alaska PD
description:
S01 E04 — Arctic Survival
Officer Chris Cook questions his future in remote Kotzebue; officer Stephanie Jones has to battle her own soft-hearted nature to succeed as a rookie; officer Christopher Zenyuch is eager to prove himself in Fairbanks.

title: Alaska PD
description:
S01 E05 — Love and Hate in Alaska
Sgt. Norman Hughes and Officer Robert Odom grapple with the distrust of the police as they try to keep Kotzebue safe; Sgt. Nathan Werner and Officer Gerrit Butler bring a personal touch in dealing with alcohol and drug-fueled crimes.

title: The First 48
description:
S16 E06 — Fast Friends; The Thin Line
A young Cleveland father is murdered in his car, and the police suspect his friend has information on the killer's identity; homicide detectives hunt for a shotgun-toting killer.

title: The First 48
description:
S16 E03 — Lying in Wait; With This Ring
Two Atlanta men are ambushed at gunpoint, and only one survives the ordeal; a wedding ring provides a clue in the case of a mother's fatal stabbing.

title: The First 48
description:
S16 E02 — Ringside Seat
Homicide detectives wander into a dark world of drugs and prostitution to solve an execution-style murder in a motel parking lot.

title: The First 48
description:
S16 E11 — Soldier Down; Blood Vendetta
A young father killed at an abandoned Atlanta car wash may have been the victim of gang violence; a Gulf War veteran is shot dead in a park.

title: The First 48
description:
S17 E12 — Bloody Valentine; Storm Warning
A man is shot to death while visiting his son in Tulsa, Okla.; a home invasion in Atlanta that killed a teenager and wounded two others may have been a contract killing.

title: The First 48
description:
S18 E14 — Bullets Have No Names
When a stray bullet kills a retired preschool teacher, Atlanta detectives need a witness to break the code of silence surrounding the crime.

title: The First 48
description:
S19 E20 — Bad Lick & Red Dawn
After a generous Atlanta man is murdered, Detective Egbert suspects he may have been a victim of his own kindness; in Tulsa, Okla., a man is shot while driving down the street; Sgt. Walker questions youths who tried to break into the victim's house.

title: Booked: First Day In
description:
S01 E01 — Jail or Bail
Every day, tens of thousands of people get booked into jails all across the country for crimes, both big and small; "Booked: First Day In" is their side of the story.

title: Booked: First Day In
description:
S01 E02 — Birthdays, Booze and Bail, Oh My!
First-timers and frequent flyers get booked, including the son of a deputy who is charged with stealing a dog he's been caring for.

title: Booked: First Day In
description:
S01 E03 — Hooked & Booked
A career criminal and first-time arrestee held in custody; an expecting father faces the prospect of missing his child's birth; a 20-year-old aspiring model gets a taste of the inside of a jail cell for the first time.

title: Booked: First Day In
description:
S01 E04 — Fathers, Fists and Fights
Two fathers get into an altercation; a guy gets caught when he uses fake urine for a drug test; a lady sets her boyfriend's things on fire.

title: Booked: First Day In
description:
S01 E05 — Come in on Vacation Leave on Probation
Life lessons are learned when a first-timer and folks familiar with the system get booked; a woman struggles to deal with her husband's health issues and gets a DWI; a father draws attention to himself, resulting in a gun possession charge.

title: Booked: First Day In
description:
S01 E09 — Barking Up the Wrong Tree
A man is arrested after getting in a fight with his girlfriend's ex over a litter of puppies.

title: Booked: First Day In
description:
S01 E10 — No Bond, No Problem
Young adults learn the hard way that their actions have consequences; three young men exploring abandoned buildings get charged with felony burglary; a young lady's play fighting with her boyfriend lands her in jail for the weekend.
